# Arantxa Barcia: DESIGN.md
> editorial film reel on warm paper

**Theme:** light  
**Source:** https://www.arantxabarcia.com/ · 2026-09-29

Source measurements are normalised; roles and recommendations are interpreted.

A director's portfolio that behaves like a printed contact sheet: paper white, one full-bleed portrait, and type doing the rest. The name lands first, set in Editorial at weight 200 and 132px, so thin it reads as a signature rather than a headline; beneath it two lines of 11px Mono in wide uppercase tracking act as a caption. Monument takes over further down, uppercase and tight at 58px, naming films as if they were credits. Warm cream #f7f1e8 and blush #f5d9d3 blocks interrupt the white without ever raising their voice, and a single dusty rose family supplies every hairline, accent and link. Nothing is rounded, nothing casts a shadow, nothing moves faster than a fade. The result is a photographer's calm: huge quiet surfaces, micro-labels, and one portrait looking straight back.

## At a glance

- **Typography:** Editorial at 200 sets the name; Monument uppercase and Mono micro-labels frame everything else.
- **Imagery:** Tight full-bleed portraits, soft flat light, one black cap in focus. Warm honest skin, no grading, no lifestyle props.
- **Logo:** No symbol: the name is the hero, drawn in thin Editorial, and echoed as a tiny Mono wordmark in the header.
- **Motion:** Quiet and filmic: opacity over 0.42s ease-out, hovers on cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) at 0.24s.
- **Color:** Paper white and warm cream with one dusty rose family and near-black ink.
- **Iconography:** Filled Lucide glyphs only, 9px inline and 18px once, no strokes, no hand-drawn marks.
- **Voice:** Terse uppercase credits, no first person. "FILM DIRECTOR AND ART DIRECTOR".
- **Framework:** Next.js

## Colors

| Name | Value | Group | Role |
|------|-------|-------|------|
| Paper White | `#ffffff` | neutral | Dominant page surface: the wall everything else is pinned to, from the hero to the work list. |
| Ink | `#111111` | neutral | All type, all 1px rules and the button border. Never pure black; the slight lift keeps it filmic. |
| Warm Paper | `#f7f1e8` | neutral | Second surface for reading blocks; a cream that separates long copy from the white gallery. |
| Blush | `#f5d9d3` | brand | Soft pink wash behind and around portrait imagery; the site's warmth without saturation. |
| Rosewater | `#e0afa8` | brand | Hairline borders and rules on light ground (the near-identical #d9a9a2 is folded in here). |
| Clay | `#c08078` | brand | Accent text and ASCII marks; the single warm signal used to point at things. |
| Espresso | `#3b2320` | brand | Deep brown used inside ASCII and art blocks, where Ink would feel too flat. |
| Muted Clay | `#8a5f58` | brand | Quiet link tone, as on the FOR AGENTS link: darker than Clay so it reads as type, not decoration. |

## Typography

### Editorial (display)
A high-contrast serif used at a single weight, 200. It carries the name and the italic reading passages and never touches UI.
- **Fallback:** Georgia, serif
- **Weights:** 200
- **Sizes:** 132px hero name, 37px italic reading
- **Line height:** 
- **Letter spacing:** -0.01em

### Monument (body)
The structural voice: 400 for body copy and the skip link, 700 for every uppercase title. Tight negative tracking keeps the big lines from feeling shouty.
- **Fallback:** Arial, sans-serif
- **Weights:** 400, 700
- **Sizes:** 16px body, 38px and 58px uppercase headings
- **Line height:** 
- **Letter spacing:** -0.015em to -0.025em when large

### Mono (mono)
The signature decision: every label, nav item, button and caption is 11px mono, uppercase, letter-spaced .08em.
- **Fallback:** monospace
- **Weights:** 400
- **Sizes:** 11px labels, nav, buttons
- **Line height:** 14px to 18px
- **Letter spacing:** 0.08em

### Type scale

| Role | Family | Weight | Size | Line height | Letter spacing |
|------|--------|--------|------|-------------|----------------|
| caption | Mono | 400 | 11px | 1.27 | 0.08em |
| body-sm | Monument | 400 | 13px | 1.38 | normal |
| body | Monument | 400 | 16px | 1.5 | normal |
| subtitle | Editorial | 200 | 37px | 1.24 | -0.01em |
| title-sm | Monument | 700 | 38px | 1.21 | -0.015em |
| title | Monument | 700 | 58px | 0.97 | -0.025em |
| display | Editorial | 200 | 132px | 1 | -0.01em |

## Spacing and layout

**Density:** airy

- **Base unit:** 4px
- **Max page width:** 100% (full-bleed sections, editorial feature capped at min(720px, 60vw))
- **Section gap:** 160px
- **Card padding:** 
- **Element gap:** 32px gutter, 24px and 64px between blocks

### Border radii

- **all surfaces and controls:** 0px
- **circular marks and avatars:** 50% / 999px pill

## Elevation

None. The system is deliberately flat: depth is made from colour bands (white, Warm Paper, Blush, Ink) and 1px rules, never from shadows.

## Components

### Header
**Role:** fixed top bar

Paper White field, 32px side gutters, wordmark in caption Mono 11/14 uppercase at left, WORK and ABOUT as caption nav at right; no border, no shadow, sits directly on the page.

### Primary button
**Role:** VIEW WORK

Transparent fill, 1px Ink border, 0 radius, min-height 36px, padding 9px 18px, caption Mono 11/16 uppercase at 0.08em. Hover fills Ink with Paper White text; active keeps the same box, no offset.

### Nav button
**Role:** WORK, ABOUT

Borderless caption Mono 11/14 uppercase in Ink, padding 0; hover fades to Clay #c08078 over 0.42s ease-out.

### Text link
**Role:** FOR AGENTS, inline credits

Mono 11/18 uppercase in Muted Clay #8a5f58, tracking 0.08em, no underline; hover resolves to Ink.

### Work row
**Role:** project list item

Full-bleed row on Paper White with a 1px top rule in Rosewater or Ink; title Monument 58/56 uppercase at left, Mono caption (period, disciplines) at right; hover reveals the project image with an opacity fade.

## Motion

Content fades in rather than sliding: 0.42s ease-out for opacity reveals, 0.24s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) for hover opacity and filter. Scroll-triggered appearances, no bounce, no scale.

## Layout

Single column, full-bleed imagery alternating with 160px-padded text sections; 32px page gutter. The hero stacks name, two-line caption and button; the work list is a flat ledger of rules and 58px titles.

## Imagery

Full-bleed close crops of a single face, lit soft and flat, one black cap with rainbow embroidery as the only saturated object. Warm, ungraded skin; the crop is tight enough that the portrait becomes texture.

## Do and don't

### Do
- Set the name in Editorial 200 at 132px with -0.01em tracking; never bold it.
- Use Mono 11px uppercase at 0.08em for every label, nav item and button.
- Keep every surface flat: 0 radius, no shadow, 1px Ink or Rosewater rules.
- Alternate Paper White with Warm Paper #f7f1e8 sections on a 160px rhythm.
- Let one full-bleed portrait carry the hero; give it the blush field to sit on.

### Don't
- Don't use pure #000 or neutral greys; the only dark is Ink #111111.
- Don't put Editorial into body copy, buttons or labels; it is display only.
- Don't add rounded corners, cards or shadows to the work list.
- Don't set labels, nav or CTAs in sentence case; they stay uppercase.
- Don't introduce saturated colours beyond the dusty rose family.
